founders.name: Sato Kenji
founders.title: The Lifer
founders.bio: Thirty-one years at the same desk. Has never once been promoted and has never once been wrong.

founders.name: Hoshino Mari
founders.title: The Closer
founders.bio: Left a bigger firm on a Friday with the client list in her handbag.

founders.name: Okada Tetsuo
founders.title: The Fixer
founders.bio: Legal, technically. Nobody has seen the contract he is always carrying.

founders.name: Nakagawa Yui
founders.title: The Wunderkind
founders.bio: Twenty-four. Shipped the product before the company existed.

founders.name: Moriyama Hiro
founders.title: The Manager
founders.bio: Has a whiteboard. Has never written on it. Everyone works harder near it anyway.

founders.name: Ueda Kaori
founders.title: The Nurturer
founders.bio: Runs HR like a kitchen. People stay for the food and the not-being-fired.

founders.name: The Founder
founders.title: Deceased, 1987
founders.bio: Still listed on the letterhead. Still signs the quarterly memo. The signature is fresh.

founders.name: Kitamura Sho
founders.title: The Salaryman
founders.bio: Ordinary in every respect. The lift stops at B1 for him and nobody else.
